leakage_audit.scope: The executable generic generator and serialized training input only. The broader repository contains prior classical-law fixtures and is not claimed exposure-free.

scope: Gate-eligible recovery of a known three-column scaling from a fresh NASA catalog lane under revised, predeclared empirical coverage gates. PASS completes Task 1 as an engineering calibration only. It does not establish creative superiority, historical novelty, or independent physical confirmation because catalog parameters may be inferred, dependent, or repeated across literature references.

source.dependency_warning: The archive fields are real published catalog parameters, but some semi-major axes and masses are inferred or model-dependent. Alternate references for one object are not independent experiments.

target_opening.data_dependency_warning: Exoplanet catalog semi-major axes and stellar masses may be inferred, model-dependent, or algebraically coupled to periods. Recovery is an instrument calibration on real catalog values, not an independent empirical confirmation of the physical law.
target_opening.equivalence_rule: primitive integer exponent vectors are sign-normalized by requiring the first nonzero entry to be positive; exact vector equality is then required
target_opening.historical_interpretation: Kepler/Newton two-body scaling in archive units

uncertainty_policy.revision_reason: Version 1's 0.90 one-sigma minimum was not a statistically calibrated one-sigma criterion. Version 2 preregisters coverage floors around the Gaussian 0.6827/0.9545 references and adds a p90 standardized-residual cap. Version 1 remains REJECT and is never rescored.
